title: Pixel Office
description: Visualize your AI agents as pixel art characters in a virtual office

emptyState.title: Your office is empty
emptyState.description: Start a task in the Kanban or open terminals to see your AI agents appear at their desks with live activity tracking.

pendingOnly: Agents will start as soon as the tasks are launched

toolbar.shortcuts: Shortcuts: +/- zoom · G grid · M sound · ←/→ agent · Esc close

activityDescription.typingWithTask: Implementing "{{task}}" — the agent is actively writing code.
activityDescription.running: The agent is running a command (tests, build, install…). Wait for it or interrupt it.
activityDescription.reading: The agent is analysing the project files.
activityDescription.waiting: The agent is waiting for your answer or an approval.
activityDescription.idle: The agent is available. Give it an order or start Claude.
activityDescription.pending: This task is waiting to start. Launch it from the Kanban.

phaseDescription.planning: The AI is analysing your request and preparing a detailed action plan.
phaseDescription.coding: Code is being written. Subtasks run one after another automatically.
phaseDescription.qa_review: An agent is checking the quality of the code produced: tests, consistency, best practices.
phaseDescription.qa_fixing: Problems were found. The agent is fixing them before delivery.
phaseDescription.rate_limit_paused: The Claude API hit its limit. It will resume automatically in a moment.
phaseDescription.auth_failure_paused: Authentication problem. Check your Claude profiles in the settings.
phaseDescription.complete: The task is complete and ready for your review.
phaseDescription.failed: The task failed. Check the logs to understand what happened.

bubble.sendHint: ↵ Enter to send · Typed straight into the terminal

pending.description: This task is queued and has not started yet. Go to the Kanban to launch it, reprioritise it or edit its specification.
